`projects.json` has the layout of the Green Climate Fund API's `projects.json` (`api.gcfund.org/v1/projects`) cut to eight projects (FP001 to FP005, FP021, FP025, FP029) and to the fields `ProjectsID`, `ApprovedRef`, `ProjectName`, `ApprovalDate`, `Status`, `Countries` (reduced to `ISO3`), `TotalGCFFunding`, `Funding` and `Disbursements`. The layout, approval refs, dates, country codes, currencies and the undated zero disbursements are real. The project names, entities, identifiers and amounts are invented; a EUR project (FP021) and a two-country project (FP005) are kept for the tests.
